rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: General Notice 444 of 1994: Chief Justice M. M. Corbett, by a notice dated 4 May 1994, fixed Monday 9 May 1994 at 11:00, in the Chamber of Parliament, Cape Town, for the nomination and election of a President of the Republic and thereafter of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-09 only. Election, oath, inauguration, resignation announcement, resignation effect and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded.
